item.title: Greek Week fosters community and philanthropy across UM chapters
item.description: The University of Miami’s Greek Week celebration is a week-long fundraiser that brings together all 33 Greek organizations on campus to raise money for a cause through friendly competition and social events. item.title: Tricanes hosts UM’s first triathlon event on campus
item.description: The University of Miami’s triathlon club, Tricanes, hosted its first ever on-campus triathlon. A total of 120 students participated in Sunday’s Try-a-Tri event.
